greeting: Hello! 👋 I'm an automated bot. Someone will reply to you soon.
menu_footer: Send a command using the prefix "{prefix}"
cmd_lang_set: ✅ Language for this chat set to: {language}
cmd_sticker_usage:
📎 Send or reply to an image/video with {prefix}sticker to create a sticker.
Flags: crop (default) / full / circle / borda
cmd_sticker_error: ❌ Could not create the sticker. Try again with an image or a short video.
cmd_stickerpack_usage: 📦 Reply to several images with {prefix}pack <name> or send an album to create a sticker pack.
cmd_unknown: ❓ Unknown command. Send {prefix}menu to see the command list.
call_rejected: 📵 Voice/video calls are not answered by this automated number. Please send a text message.
welcome_message: 👋 Welcome, {user}! Glad to have you in {group}.
cmd_ping_desc: Checks if the bot is online
cmd_sticker_desc: Creates a sticker from an image/video
cmd_pack_desc: Creates a sticker pack: .pack <name> to start, .pack fim to finish
cmd_owner_only: 🔒 Only the bot owner can use this command.
cmd_group_only: 👥 This command only works in groups.
cmd_pack_started:
📦 Pack "*{pack}*" started! Send the images/videos now.
When you are done, send "{prefix}pack fim".
cmd_admin_only: 🛡️ Only group admins can use this command.
cmd_bot_not_admin: ⚠️ I need to be a group admin to do that.
cmd_group_no_target: 👤 Mention someone or reply to their message.
cmd_group_invalid_number: 📱 Provide the number with country code. E.g. .add 5511999999999
cmd_group_add_private: 📨 This person does not allow being added by strangers — send them the invite privately.
cmd_group_closed: 🔒 Group closed: only admins can send messages.
cmd_group_opened: 🔓 Group opened: everyone can send messages.
cmd_kick_desc: Removes someone from the group (mention or reply)
cmd_add_desc: Adds a number to the group
cmd_circle_desc: Turns a photo/video into a circular sticker
cmd_circle_usage: ⭕ Reply to a photo or video with this command to turn it into a circular sticker.
cmd_steal_desc: Steals the quoted sticker, replacing pack/author with yours
cmd_steal_usage: 🥷 Reply to a sticker with this command to make it yours.
cmd_rename_desc: Steals the sticker with a custom pack/author (remembers yours): rename Pack / Author
cmd_rename_usage:
🥷 Reply to a sticker with "{prefix}rename Pack / Author".
Saved once — next time, just "{prefix}rename" alone reuses it.
cmd_rename_saved: ✅ Saved! Next time, *rename* alone will use "{pack} / {author}".
